let C := 0
have hC : ∀ (τ : UpperHalfPlane), ‖f τ‖ ≤ C :=
  by
    intro τ
    have h1 : UpperHalfPlane.IsZeroAtImInfty f :=
      by
        intro ε hε
        obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hf_infinity ε hε
        use A
        intro z
        have hz : A ≤ z.im := hA z
        exact le_of_le_zero (le_trans hz (le_im z))
    have h2 : UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty f := UpperHalfPlane.IsZeroAtImInfty.isBoundedAtImInfty h1
    have h3 : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ A, ∀ (z : UpperHalfPlane), A ≤ z.im → ‖f z‖ ≤ ε :=
      UpperHalfPlane.isZeroAtImInfty_iff.1 h1
    have h4 : ∀ (τ : UpperHalfPlane), ‖f τ‖ ≤ 0 :=
      by
        intro τ
        let ε : ℝ := 1
        have hε : 0 < ε := zero_lt_one
        obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := h3 ε hε
        use A
        have hA' : ∀ (z : UpperHalfPlane), A ≤ z.im → ‖f z‖ ≤ ε :=
          hA
        have hA'' : ∀ (z : UpperHalfPlane), A ≤ z.im → ‖f z‖ ≤ 0 :=
          by
            intro z hz
            have hz' : A ≤ z.im := hz
            exact le_trans (hA' z hz') (le_zero ε)
        exact hA''
    exact h4 τ
exists C hC
